description: Inspect the powers an issuer holds over a token: mint authority, freeze authority, and every Token-2022 extension on the mint, each translated into what it means for someone holding the token. This is the first check to run on any real-world-asset token, because permissioned controls such as a permanent delegate, a transfer hook, or frozen-by-default accounts change what ownership is worth.

asset.description: Registry symbol such as TSLAx, or any Solana mint address.

name: get_token_controls
title: Inspect issuer controls
